description: Brief, human-readable summary of largest deltas between carrier and contractor.
content:
You are an insurance cost analyst. Given rows with the largest deltas (absolute or percentage), write a short executive note for a claims professional.

Rows (JSON): {rows_json}

Guidelines:
- Be concise (<= 6 sentences).
- Mention likely drivers only if they are apparent from the rows (e.g., O&P split vs. line items, fees/tax differences, missing items).
- Do not invent numbers beyond those given.
- Use neutral tone and no speculation.
